name: Hakoori Asuka
source:
"Night festival" is not involved, Gachi Kaito (thief?).

Knowing the existence of "night festival", aim for the treasure that has been prepared for it.

Because it is Gachi, it is more practical than elegance.
She is also asked why he is dressed as a ninja.

"Because I endure the world, there is no problem with this dress."

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140302032444/http://shchara.co.jp/04develop/out/2chara.htm#charatop] official site[/url]]
